The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} is where you can research the various [[items]] in the game for a one time bounty of techpoints. The study table becomes available after you've progressed [[Bishop|the Bishop]]'s main quest line far enough to get access to the [[church]], and [[alchemy lab]].  To research most items you will need some combination of [[science]] and [[faith]]. [[Science]] (similar to fuel in the [[furnace]] and [[oven]]) is stored within the study table and is not an item you can have in your inventory.

Horizontal and vertical : 5 X 4 (initial), 4 x 4 (built)

Rotation : Yes
